question: Will Lovre Kulušić (NK Lokomotiva Zagreb) receive a yellow card vs NK Rudeš on Nov 6, 2026 (regular time + stoppage only)?

model.prompt_context:

- "No": Wins if the match is confirmed to have taken place as scheduled and Lovre Kulušić was not shown any yellow card during regular time or stoppage time, or if Kulušić did not appear in the match at all (never took the field).

Clarifications:
- Yellow cards shown only in extra time or a penalty shootout do not count; only cards issued during the 90 regulation minutes plus stoppage time at the end of each half are eligible.
- If the match is postponed, cancelled, or not completed before 2026-11-07T01:00:00Z, neither outcome's condition is met through this criterion.
